description: This file is a Java interface defining data access methods for CustomerOptionSet entities, including retrieval methods based on various criteria such as option ID, store, and language.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDao
classes.description: An interface extending a generic DAO for CustomerOptionSet entity, providing methods to retrieve customer option sets based on different criteria.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific option ID within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists CustomerOptionSet entities available in a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its unique ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerOptionSet entities based on their option value ID within a store.
